title: Prop 15.131: pair-avg vs basepoint ED4; p=7 three-type Q_δ; true δ²; pointwise max-Q criterion
settlement_note: No soft-close. Clarifies that W-based ED4 at p=7 is basepoint Q_δ(hs), not pair-avg δ². True δ²=19180800/1840091 and max Q_δ=200448/4499 ≤ ρ_min² (slack 812048/220451). Residual holds at p=7 with either criterion. General p still OPEN. N_ED4_SUF OPEN. L OPEN.

pair_vs_basepoint.theorem: ED4(y)=flat+24 Q_δ(y); ED4_pair=flat+24 δ²; when Q non-constant, ED4(hs)≠ED4_pair (p=7).

spectrum.theorem: Exactly 3 ED4/Q_δ types on Max+ at p=7; Q can be negative; counts 2352/8400/700.

true_delta2.note: Prior W-based 82176/4499 was Q_δ(hs), not δ²; true δ² is smaller (more residual slack).

pointwise.theorem: max Q_δ ≤ ρ_min² at p=7 ⇒ δ² ≤ ρ_min² ⇒ Path C residual (15.130.C).

var_Q.theorem: Var(Q_δ)>0 at p=7 ⇒ pointwise criterion strictly stronger than δ²≤ρ_min²; Max+ not 2-point homogeneous for 4th moment.

open.open: Prove max Q_δ≤ρ_min² (or δ²≤ρ_min² / E‖Pf‖²≤room / Aut-line Q_0) for all primes p≥7; at p=5 use hyp form.
open.aut_line_caveat_p7: Q_δ non-constant at p=7 ⇒ either dim E_4p^{Aut}>1 or Aut does not act transitively on Max+ Q-level sets; halfspace pin alone is not the residual value (Q_hs ≠ δ²).

open_attack: Prove max_y Q_δ(y)≤ρ_min² for all primes p≥7 (or δ²≤ρ_min² / E‖P f‖²≤room / careful Aut-line with non-constant Q). At p=5 use hyp form.
